UnoStudio 3.3.0-dev.136+9290ebfb2ad546c1f839fad07d6829495d81a9f8
Uno Studio CLI — work with Studio Live Projects from your own git client
Usage: build
Description: Build a preview of an application and write the package, the log, the result and the descriptor
Options:
  --source <string>  Repository root as checked out. Never written to.
  --out <string>  Directory to write the package, the log, the result and the descriptor to
  --project <string>  The application to build, relative to --source. Required when the repository holds several.
  --target <string>  Surface to build for. Only the web surface is served today. [default: wasm]
  --timeout-minutes <int>  Minutes before the build is abandoned [default: 30]
  --minibuild-version <string>  Advanced: build against a specific mini-build version instead of the paired one
  --minibuild-cache <string>  Advanced: where to cache the downloaded mini-build
  --strict  Fail instead of warning when the mini-build version was overridden
  --certify  Declare in the descriptor that a signed certification will be published beside it
  --repository <string>  Advanced: the repository, as owner/repo. Read from the runner when omitted.
  --head-sha <string>  Advanced: the commit being reviewed. Read from the runner when omitted.
  --pr <int>  Advanced: the pull-request number. Read from the runner when omitted.
  --run-id <long>  Advanced: the run identifier. Read from the runner when omitted.

UnoStudio 3.3.0-dev.136+9290ebfb2ad546c1f839fad07d6829495d81a9f8
Uno Studio CLI — work with Studio Live Projects from your own git client
Usage: setup
Description: Configure your git client to authenticate with Studio Live using your Uno Platform license
Options:
  --dry-run  Show the planned configuration changes without applying them
  --remove  Remove the Studio Live credential configuration instead of installing it
  --proactive-auth, --no-proactive-auth  Let git supply credentials before being asked, avoiding an extra round trip (default: on)
  --helper-command <string>  Advanced: the exact credential helper command to configure
  --absolute-path  Advanced: configure this executable's full path instead of the installed tool name
